decisions.purpose: Establish consistent return-focus, reduced-motion zero-transition safety, high-DPI zoom legibility, and retained tool polish without replacing Orca visual language.
decisions.question: How to guarantee deterministic Escape focus return across controlled <Dialog open> flows and clean responsive layout on 600x400 / 158% zoom across retained tools?
decisions.judgment: Standardize controlled dialog trigger return-focus (dialog-return-focus.ts), clamp CSS motion transitions under reduced-motion, bind external @container/git-graph rules, fix unpackaged orca-runtime.mjs resolution, and align trilingual localization catalogs.
decisions.choice: Apply scoped Radix/CJS fixes in Porpita renderer/main rather than rewriting dialog primitives.

comparison.rationale: Central trigger tracking handles external openers cleanly with minimal code delta and zero shadcn restyle regression.

approval.scope: Windows hidden CDP observation + E2E M1-A/M1-B/M1-C suite

checks.finding: Controlled <Dialog open> Escape restores exact trigger focus (Add project / Skip Continue / StarNagCard); BrowserFind role=search and plugin toggle focus recovery verified.

gaps.impact: Visible OS foreground focus, Windows Narrator/macOS VoiceOver/Linux Orca AT-SPI, and macOS/Linux/ARM64 installers require non-hidden physical OS runs.
gaps.question: How are real AT-SPI / Narrator announcements and native traffic-light titlebars verified across platforms?

decisions.purpose: Eliminate stale ACS connection/unread state across reconnects and settings round-trips while keeping Native Session and ACS Conversation authorities distinct.
decisions.question: How should Sidebar, Settings, and Collaboration Dialog stay synchronized during reconnect, p1_only server downgrade, and pending message failures?
decisions.judgment: Introduce shared collaboration-connection-sync and communication-view-sync with 200ms unmount grace, p1_only fallback polling, visible before pendingFailed order in PendingInspectionAction, and Managed Core messages.newest validation.
decisions.choice: Unify connection/snapshot event propagation while keeping P1/P2 server capabilities explicit.

alternatives: Merging ACS Conversation into Native Session store
comparison.rationale: Preserves domain separation (D-001..D-009) while removing duplicate /snapshot fetches and stale reconnect badges.

approval.scope: PostgreSQL 16 loopback ACS Core observation + M2 E2E 15/15 full pass

checks.finding: Side-by-side connect/disconnect/reconnect preserves unread badge, clears stale search hits, respects p1_only polling, and renders 109px compact history height at 600x400.

gaps.impact: Live authenticated LLM streaming responses (EB-01), OAuth task SaaS accounts (EB-02), and physical multi-host HTTPS ACS clusters (EB-03) cannot be exercised offline without external keys/machines.
